purpose: One signed-in UI QA run at a time on the shared UI harness and the shared QA logins. It coordinates orchestrators (CI qa_agent.py, the Ops Console's Run QA); it is not a security boundary: the harness execution role can write the bucket.
bucket: the QA reports bucket (qa_agent.py --bucket, env QA_BUCKET)

fieldRules.runId: the holder's run or session id; the reset broker checks it
fieldRules.acquiredAt: UTC, timeFormat; set at acquire or takeover, never changed by a renewal
fieldRules.expiresAt: UTC, timeFormat; the only expiry. S3 never deletes the object for us (lifecycle rules work in days)

rules.acquire: PutObject with IfNoneMatch='*'. Created: you hold it; keep the returned ETag. If the create gets 412/409 but the read then gets 404 (the holder just released), retry the create at once.
rules.busy: On 412 or 409, GetObject. If now < expiresAt + clockSkewSeconds, the lock is held: poll every pollSeconds until your wait ends, then stop before any harness call ('harness busy').
rules.takeover: If now >= expiresAt + clockSkewSeconds, or the body is not a lease with all leaseFields and valid times, PutObject with IfMatch=<the ETag you read>. 412/409/404 means someone else moved first: go back to busy.
rules.renew: Every renewEverySeconds, from a timer or thread so a long streaming invoke cannot outlive the lease: PutObject with IfMatch=<your ETag>, the same acquiredAt and a new expiresAt = now + ttlSeconds. 412/409/404 means the lease is lost. Any other error is retried next beat, but if no renewal has succeeded for ttlSeconds - clockSkewSeconds the lease counts as lost all the same: another run may already hold it.
rules.release: DeleteObject with IfMatch=<your ETag>. 412/409/404 means it is no longer yours: delete nothing.
rules.checkBeforeEachStep: Before every signed-in step (each QA pass, each reset-broker call), check the lease is not lost. Once lost: start no further step, and report the run UNKNOWN.
rules.etagOwnership: Whoever holds the latest ETag owns renew and release. The ETag changes on every create, takeover and renewal, so an async holder (e.g. a worker the Ops Console's Run QA starts) must carry the latest ETag forward and use only that one.
